scope: Demo preflight only. This task does not build the component or edit course.yaml, lesson.mdx, registries, UI primitives, or research briefs.

source_state.course_demo_spec: Detect a -40 dB tone 5.5 original bins from a stronger tone by choosing window and record length before relative phase is randomized. Pass only when the weak peak remains at least 3 dB above local leakage for every tested phase; rectangular-window failure falsifies narrowest-is-best.
source_state.authority_note: The course spec fixes the learning target but not enough arithmetic conventions to produce one reproducible verdict. The executable repair below is a proposal and must be adopted by an authorized authoring step before implementation.

d1.sentence: The learner changes window and acquired record length and watches the worst-phase weak-tone margin cross a fixed 3 dB boundary, including a rectangular-window failure and a short low-sidelobe-window failure that jointly falsify narrowest-is-best and universally-lowest-sidelobe heuristics.
d1.why_not_static: A static comparison can show one spectrum, but it cannot make the learner commit to a window-duration pair, audit the same pair over a phase grid, locate the worst phase, and discover that both sidelobe height and main-lobe width can control the result.
d1.goal_alignment: The interaction reports main-lobe width, peak sidelobe, coherent gain, scalloping loss, ENBW, local leakage, and the all-phase decision, directly serving the lesson goal of evaluating rather than visually preferring windows.
d1.honesty_boundary: This is a normalized, noiseless, two-complex-tone finite-record study. It demonstrates one local detection criterion; it is not a universal detector, probability-of-detection study, real-signal periodogram, or claim that one window is globally best.

blockers.ambiguity: The spec does not say real cosine versus complex exponential, strong-tone coordinate, absolute phase, sampling rate, noise rule, or amplitude-versus-power meaning of -40 dB.
blockers.consequence: Real and complex signals have different image leakage, and different strong-tone offsets can reverse a window verdict.
blockers.repair: Adopt proposed_executable_contract.signal exactly, including a complex strong line of amplitude 1, complex weak line of amplitude 0.01, no noise, and fixed normalized frequencies.

blockers.ambiguity: Window names, coefficient sets, and symmetric-versus-periodic endpoint conventions are absent.
blockers.consequence: Hann/Blackman-Harris values, coherent gain, null width, and leakage differ across conventions.
blockers.repair: Adopt the four periodic, denominator-N definitions and coefficients frozen below.

blockers.ambiguity: The phrase '5.5 original bins' does not identify the reference length, and no legal record lengths are specified.
blockers.consequence: Changing N can either change physical separation or only the coordinate label; the demo cannot know which experiment it is performing.
blockers.repair: Freeze N0=128, keep physical frequencies fixed at q/128 cycles/sample, and allow N in [64,128,256].

blockers.ambiguity: Neither the phase distribution nor the number of tests is stated, while runtime randomization conflicts with reproducible SSR and stable target completion.
blockers.consequence: Two learners can receive different verdicts and server/client markup can diverge if Math.random enters initialization.
blockers.repair: Replace randomization with the exhaustive deterministic 16-phase grid 0 through 337.5 degrees in 22.5-degree steps; call it a withheld test grid, not random data.

blockers.ambiguity: The spec does not define the weak neighborhood, spectral evaluation grid, whether leakage is strong-only or total-spectrum background, how the weak peak is selected, dB normalization, or the inclusive 3 dB comparison.
blockers.consequence: Exact-frequency, FFT-bin, neighborhood-maximum, and pointwise-envelope metrics give different margins, especially when a record makes the line bin-centered.
blockers.repair: Adopt the normalized exact-DTFT neighborhood-maximum metric below and decide on raw values with margin >=3.000 dB; rounding is display-only.

blockers.ambiguity: No lesson.mdx exists, so D4 cannot verify that the learner is asked to make a choice before the result, use the same preset names, or interpret the success criterion correctly.
blockers.consequence: A technically correct widget could become an unguided sandbox or disclose the answer before the prediction.
blockers.repair: Author the three frozen guided tasks below before the Demo embed, then authorize component and registry work separately.

not_blockers: No network, audio, file upload, worker, timer, random number, or new dependency is required.
Panel, PresetGroup, Button, Slider, Readout, and TargetList are sufficient.
The finite study is small enough for synchronous client computation or frozen lookup tables.

coordinate_system.original_bin_coordinate: q=N0*f; one original bin is 1/128 cycles/sample
coordinate_system.record_length_rule: Changing N changes acquired duration only. Sampling rate and the two physical normalized frequencies remain fixed; it does not reinterpret q as a bin index of the new record.
coordinate_system.spectral_evaluator: Exact DTFT sums at declared q values; never call the plotted samples FFT bins.

signal.image_component: none; complex tones intentionally isolate positive-frequency window leakage
signal.calibration_note: -40 dB means 20*log10(0.01/1), not a power-ratio ambiguity.

window_metric_definitions.scalloping_loss_db: 20*log10(|W at one-half current-record bin offset|/sum_n w[n])
window_metric_definitions.main_lobe_width: distance in current-record DFT-bin units between the first exact nulls surrounding zero
window_metric_definitions.peak_sidelobe_db: maximum 20*log10(|W|/sum w) outside the first-null interval through Nyquist; expected values above use a dense deterministic grid and are display references, not the local detector metric
window_metric_definitions.normalization_guard: CG corrects a bin-centered line amplitude; ENBW and sidelobe numbers must not be conflated with the local weak-tone margin.

phase_grid.semantics: The learner chooses window and N before revealing the all-phase audit. No runtime randomization is used. A phase slider may inspect the 16 cases, but the verdict is always their minimum margin.

local_leakage_metric.evaluation_grid: G={25.5+r/64 | r=0,...,64}; 65 points including both endpoints
local_leakage_metric.pass_rule: PASS iff M_min >= 3.000 dB using unrounded double-precision values
local_leakage_metric.display_rounding: Show leakage relative to the strong line and margins to 2 decimals; rounding never controls PASS/FAIL.
local_leakage_metric.reason_for_neighborhood_max: It prevents an exact null at q=26 from making a bin-centered long-record case look infinitely clean while adjacent local leakage still masks the feature.

stored_state: recordIndex: integer 0 through 2 mapping to N=[64,128,256]
derived_only: active preset index, null when the manual state matches none
16 phase margins, worst phase, all-phase PASS/FAIL
CG, ENBW, main-lobe, scalloping, and peak-sidelobe readouts
proposed_state_and_controls.initial_state: Rectangular trap: Rectangular, N=128, phase 0 degrees, audit already revealed. It visibly fails with worst margin -1.62 dB although its main lobe is the narrowest, so the first screenshot is nondegenerate and falsifies narrowest-is-best.
controls: PresetGroup with exactly four labels frozen below.
Four kit Button choices for window, mutually exclusive and carrying aria-pressed.
One indexed Slider for N with positions 64, 128, 256 samples and aria-valuetext including samples.
One indexed Slider for phase with 16 positions and aria-valuetext in degrees; it changes the inspected spectrum but never weakens the all-phase verdict.
One kit Button labeled Audit all 16 phases; no random API, timer, or animation.
Reset restores the initial Rectangular trap state and clears latched task progress.
proposed_state_and_controls.choice_before_reveal: Changing window or N sets auditRevealed=false while leaving the current spectrum visible; Audit all 16 phases reveals the deterministic worst-case decision. Named presets may load their documented state and reveal immediately for narrative replay.
proposed_state_and_controls.feedback_budget: At most 3 record lengths x 4 windows x 16 phases x 65 neighborhood points x 256 samples if exhaustively recomputed, below 3.2 million short complex accumulations; prefer a frozen 12-cell audit table plus one current-phase curve. All feedback remains synchronous with no transition.

presets.label: Rectangular trap
presets.teaching_role: Initial counterexample: the 2-bin main lobe is narrowest, but local sidelobe leakage hides the -40 dB neighbor.

presets.label: Hann clears
presets.teaching_role: At the same duration, a wider main lobe purchases enough local leakage suppression to clear every tested phase.

presets.label: Short BH trap
presets.teaching_role: Excellent far sidelobes do not help when the short record places the weak line in the broad main-lobe neighborhood.

presets.label: Longer Hamming
presets.teaching_role: Increasing acquired duration changes the physical separation in current-record bin units and moves the same local window from N=128 failure to N=256 pass.

numeric_study_plan.matrix_dimensions: 4 periodic windows x 3 record lengths x 16 phases x 65 local frequency points
required_invariants: Exactly 12 finite cells and 192 phase verdicts are produced; no NaN or Infinity enters a calculation or SVG coordinate.
Rectangular N=128 fails while Hann N=128 passes.
Hamming changes from 1.428 dB FAIL at N=128 to 7.660 dB PASS at N=256.
Four-term Blackman-Harris changes from -1.311 dB FAIL at N=64 to 59.158 dB PASS at N=128.
Every decision uses unrounded margin >=3.000 dB; no displayed rounded value is fed back into the decision.
CG and ENBW equal their frozen analytic values for every N under the periodic definitions.
The exact-DTFT evaluation grid remains in original-bin coordinates when N changes; no zero-padding or FFT length control exists.
numeric_study_plan.independent_reference_check: Before component work, reproduce the 12 rows in a small standalone deterministic script using direct complex sums, then freeze them as fixtures or assert the client calculations against them.
numeric_study_plan.tolerance: Reference-table comparisons: absolute 0.005 dB for reported leakage/margin and 0.000005 for CG/ENBW; PASS/FAIL must match exactly.

guided_tasks_to_author: Start with Rectangular trap. Predict that the narrowest main lobe will win, reveal all 16 phases, and record the -1.62 dB worst margin and FAIL; this is the explicit falsification moment.

Hold N=128 and compare Hann, Hamming, and four-term Blackman-Harris. Find a pair that passes, then explain the decision using local leakage rather than only the headline peak-sidelobe number; Hamming remains a 1.43 dB near-failure under the frozen local metric.

Load Short BH trap, then increase N from 64 to 128 without moving either physical tone. Make the broad-main-lobe failure become PASS and state that acquired duration, not a denser FFT display, changed the evidence.

visual_contract.primary_plot: One SVG in original-bin q coordinates covering at least q=19 through 27. Show the normalized strong-only leakage trace, full two-tone trace for the inspected phase, vertical strong/weak frequency markers, the q=[25.5,26.5] local bracket, the local leakage level, and the observed neighborhood peak. Do not imply an FFT grid.
visual_contract.decision_readout: Readout states current phase margin, worst phase and minimum margin, literal PASS/FAIL, and the inclusive >=3 dB rule.
visual_contract.metric_cards: Compact cards show current-record main-lobe width, peak sidelobe, CG, scalloping loss, and ENBW with units. Local leakage is visually separated because it depends on N and the fixed neighbor coordinate.
visual_contract.tradeoff_message: Always name both the cost and benefit: taper can lower sidelobes while widening the main lobe and changing CG/ENBW; longer N changes physical evidence.
visual_contract.no_probability_language: Sixteen deterministic phases support an all-tested-phase claim only, not a probability, confidence, or random-channel claim.

mobile_312_360: Stack controls, SVG, decision, metrics, and targets in one column; do not render the 12-cell matrix as a horizontally scrolling table.
Use SVG viewBox plus w-full and keep axis labels inside the viewBox; no fixed-width plot or tooltip required for essential values.
Permit the four long window labels to wrap in PresetGroup/Button controls without shrinking targets below 44 px.
Show at most five metric cards in a 2-column mobile grid with text wrapping; keep PASS/FAIL and margin above the fold where practical.
accessibility: All controls use existing native kit Button, PresetGroup, and Slider primitives; button and slider hit areas are at least 44 px.
The indexed N and phase sliders provide aria-valuetext; phase values are announced in degrees.
Readout and TargetList announce audit changes politely; avoid announcing every SVG point.
The SVG has role=img and a dynamic aria-label summarizing window, N, phase, leakage, margin, and verdict.
Colors use theme tokens/currentColor and every line/status has a text label or dash style; PASS/FAIL is never color-only.
No hover-only tooltip, drag-only gesture, motion, sound, or auto-cycling phase.
ssr_client_stability: The component must begin with use client and default-export a no-required-props component; any props must be serializable.
Initial state is literal and all arithmetic is pure; do not use Math.random, Date, performance, window, canvas measurement, locale-dependent formatting, effects, or browser-only APIs during render.
Client components are prerendered by default in the local Next version, so server and first-client HTML must use the same frozen matrix and explicit decimal formatting.
Keep lazy registration as a static import string in components/demos/index.ts at the later authorized integration stage.
No ssr:false escape hatch is necessary or desirable.
responsive_accessibility_ssr_audit.implementation_size_risk: MODERATE: a plot, five metrics, three controls, four presets, and target state can exceed the approximately 200-line demo limit if formulas and the full 12-cell matrix are verbose. Keep the component to one compact data table and pure helpers, reuse UI primitives, and omit nonessential tooltips/animations.

acceptance_after_repair: An authorized course/lesson edit adopts the signal, window, coordinate, phase, local metric, presets, and guided tasks without silently substituting a different detector.
Exactly four named presets and the manual window/N controls reproduce the frozen 12-cell matrix.
Initial Rectangular trap visibly fails and falsifies narrowest-is-best before free exploration.
The all-phase verdict cannot be made to pass by selecting a favorable phase; phase is inspection-only.
Window headline metrics and target-specific local leakage remain distinct.
No FFT length or zero-padding control enters this lesson; that boundary remains owned by peak-estimation-and-zero-padding.
One default-exported client file stays near 200 physical lines, imports only components/ui, adds no dependency/network/audio/randomness, and responds synchronously.
At build time run the numeric fixture check, repeated SSR render equality, npx tsc --noEmit, scoped eslint, course validation, and manual light/dark keyboard checks at 312 and 360 px.
